description: A group of inflammatory skin reactions caused by direct contact with an irritant or allergen.

appearance.general: Variable patches of erythema, vesicles, bullae, swelling, scaling, fissuring, or lichenification.

prevention: Use protective measures appropriate to the exposure.
doctor_discussion_points: Discuss occupation, new products, exposures, and whether patch testing is needed.
